Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Set U = (λK(t1), . . . , λK(tN )), A = pU∗ Up. Then A is invertible in the unital corner pMN (C∗ r (K))p, and e = (Up)A−1 (Up)∗ (2.2) is a projection in the scalar algebra C∗ r (K) with τK(e) = a.
